svg.title: Kubernetes troubleshooting agent: architecture
svg.text: An AI agent that investigates, proposes and (after approval) fixes problems in a cluster. Everything runs on one Mac; Git is the source of truth.
Kept on your Mac, not in Git
the model; runs on the Mac's GPU, outside the
7 write actions, only after you approve
Guards in code + RBAC in Kubernetes
Code (not the model) verifies the fix
Alert runs queue: one at a time
No persistent storage here: Prometheus and Loki start empty after a rebuild.
You chat in the browser; a port-forward reaches the agent.
The agent asks the local model what it thinks.
The agent reads the cluster; after approval it patches the
Prometheus sees a problem; Alertmanager sends a webhook; the
agent investigates and stops at approval.
The agent looks up metric history and stored logs.
You push; Actions test, build the image, push it and commit
Argo CD pulls Git and applies it. Secrets arrive encrypted.
The nodes pull the private image.
